name: Malliouhana, Auberge Collection

address.street: Meads Bay British West Indies Ai

insider_take: This clifftop sanctuary sits majestically above Meads Bay and Turtle Cove, where turquoise waters meet powder-soft sand on one of the Caribbean's most pristine coastlines.
whats_special: Malliouhana boasts the rare distinction of being perched on bluffs overlooking two spectacular beaches simultaneously. The property features artwork from renowned Caribbean artists and sits on Anguilla's coveted northwest coast, where trade winds provide natural cooling. The resort's clifftop spa offers treatments with panoramic ocean views, while the infinity pool appears to merge seamlessly with the Caribbean horizon.
pro_tip: Visit during sunset hours when the clifftop location offers unobstructed views of the sun melting into the Caribbean Sea – it's consistently rated among the world's most spectacular sunset viewing spots.
dont_miss: The resort's signature beachfront dining at Meads Bay, consistently ranked among the Caribbean's top beaches. Take the private path down to both beaches for snorkeling in crystal-clear waters, and explore nearby Shoal Bay East, often cited as one of the world's most beautiful beaches, just minutes away.
pros: Stunning clifftop location overlooking Meads Bay and Turtle Cove
Exceptional spa and wellness facilities with ocean views
Multiple award-winning dining venues and culinary experiences
Luxurious suites and villas with private pools and terraces
cons: Remote Caribbean island location requires connecting flights
